stem: Which ending result or final point follows “Preservation does not always mean freezing time.”?
options: It is about choosing what parts of life should remain under personal control.

Sometimes studying history means rebuilding a tool and letting wind, water, and human skill answer part of the question.
Sometimes it means choosing which parts must remain and which parts must change so a place can live again.
